name: idea-validation-workflow
description: A client-neutral workflow for safely capturing, clarifying, promoting, executing, and reviewing Ideas through an IdeaTrace API.

interface.shortDescription: Turn natural-language Ideas into verified API workflows.
interface.longDescription: Guide proposers and executors through Idea capture, bounded clarification, explicit promotion, execution facts, structured reports, idempotent recovery, role-oriented reads, and human-governed handoff without creating a second source of truth.
defaultPrompt: Use $idea-validation-workflow to capture this Idea without promoting it.
Use $idea-validation-workflow to clarify this Idea from current public authority.
Use $idea-validation-workflow to read this project and summarize the next allowed step.
